color_vision.md.description: Biology of color vision; the human color-discrimination goggle game (a deployed web app with a color trainer and a timed, scored group competition with team leaderboard); the robot color-discrimination challenge (filtered light sensors as a 1-pixel color camera — a dichromatic two-sensor build by default, like a dog, extendable to trichromatic RGB); two local HTML web games (RGB Codebreaker for additive mixing, Color Constancy Challenge for context-dependent perception).
